name: Job WIP
office_task: Every Monday, publish the job profit and work-in-progress report: each open job's quoted value, cost to date and invoiced to date, every figure with its source and the time it was read.
systems_of_record: the job system (Simpro, ServiceM8, Fergus and the like): each open job's accepted quote plus approved variations, and its cost to date (labour at cost rate, materials and subcontract bills against the job)
the ledger (Xero or MYOB): invoices raised against each job's tracking category to date, less credit notes
the system the report is published into, which issues the report_id

emits.write: one view of the week's job WIP report per audience (owner with every open job, external accountant with the open-job totals), each figure carrying its definition id, source and as-of time, or published as unavailable with the reason; a correction is a new version superseding the old, released by the named person with the reason
emits.readback: reading the week's reports back returns each report_id with its version, published_at and published_by; no id back means it was not published and report.publish_failed is raised

emits.write: an exception naming the definition's owner or the threshold's person: a job system or ledger that could not be read, a measure with no definition or two, a threshold that could not be compared, a correction missing a person or reason, or a view that did not read back
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the week, the measure, the reason and the exception_owner
